tasks.goal: Render the existing route tabs inside the desktop header while preserving the mobile title, mobile sticky tabs and every existing tab command.
input_facts: AppLayout currently renders breadcrumb and UiTabs as separate desktop rows
UiTabs owns all route-tab commands and tabsStore owns persistent tab state
AppLayout and CSS share the same 760px mobile boundary
AppLayout.vue and styles.css contain unrelated changes that must be preserved
invariants: tabsStore remains the sole route-tab state source
UiTabs currentPath and command behavior remain unchanged
Project selector, sidebar toggle and global actions remain usable
Exactly one UiTabs instance is rendered at every viewport
No page-level horizontal overflow is introduced
interface_contracts: AppLayout continues to pass route.fullPath to UiTabs
Desktop and mobile UiTabs mount conditions are mutually exclusive at the existing breakpoint
non_goals: Do not change tabsStore, UiTabs internals, route metadata or backend APIs
Do not redesign sidebar, top navigation or business pages
Do not alter unrelated existing worktree changes
action_bounds: Modify only AppLayout mount composition and shell header/tab CSS
Use existing components, tokens and 760px breakpoint
Keep the correction reversible within the two approved files
acceptance_checks: Desktop current title appears once and the independent desktop tab row is absent
Desktop project selector, sidebar toggle, tabs and account actions do not overlap with several tabs open
Switch, close, refresh, close others and close all retain their existing outcomes
375x812, 390x844 and 430x932 retain the current title and separate sticky tabs without horizontal overflow
Frontend build and focused diff check exit successfully
Browser console contains no new errors
evidence_required: Frontend build output and exit code
Focused git diff check output and exit code
tasks.rollback: Restore the pre-task UiTabs mount location and shell header/tab style rules while preserving unrelated file changes.
stop_conditions: The correction requires changes outside the two approved files
The existing UiTabs or tabsStore public behavior must change
Mobile overflow cannot be corrected within the approved shell selectors
escalation_conditions: The user-confirmed mobile independent tab behavior must change

checks: Exercise browser desktop and mobile acceptance paths
